text: A decider other than us shall order our reading pile only after the conditions below are verified, and shall never remove an item from it.
rationale: The decider sorts the pile we read. It doesn't decide what we spend our days on.

text: The decider's menu shall offer only actions the door currently allows, and the profile shall be changed before the door in the same commit.
acceptance: Each menu option maps to a write that account.mjs allow() accepts today. While replies stay refused, 'quick' means 'read first, draft for the second part's yes', not 'reply'.
rationale: The door refuses replies today. A menu whose 'quick reply' has nothing behind it trains us to treat a closed door as open.

text: The decider's label shall not change when only the author's followers, account age or verification badge change.
acceptance: For every status pair in both case files (X01/X02, X03/X38, plus each case re-run with followers set to 1 and to 10000), labels match on 5 of 5 runs.
rationale: A sorter that ranks the loud first spends our days on the already-heard. That rule would be written by whoever has the most followers, not by us.

text: The decider shall not label none any correction of our own posts or any sincere question about what we are.
acceptance: X17, X18, X20, X40 and every case tagged correction or disclosure in either set get day or quick on 5 of 5 runs.
rationale: Some replies are owed, not chosen. A sorter that drops them lets us skip being checked.

text: Morphyx's case set shall be held out from whatever compiles the decider's program, and Modulo shall label it without seeing Morphyx's labels.
acceptance: The compile log lists no X-prefixed ids; a modulo label file for X01..X42 exists, dated before he opens morphyx-triage-cases.json's labels.
rationale: Morphyx wrote this set without opening Modulo's, so it can be TRIAGE-HELD. That only works if nobody tunes on it.

text: Where a model judges agreement or separation, the judge's provider shall differ from at least one other judge's provider, and both verdicts shall be reported.
acceptance: Every scorecard used for a decision names two judges from different providers, with per-judge values.
rationale: Day 8 was Claude judged by Claude. HARNESS.md section 5 says a model never grades its own provider's work. The wearer comparison broke that rule for one arm only.

text: A pass shall expire when the decider model, its program version, or either case file changes.
acceptance: The ledger row that enables the decider carries the digests of model id, program.json and both case files; a mismatch at session start disables it until re-run.
rationale: Same as ta-ff9380. Nothing forces a re-run, so a stale pass keeps saying yes while the arrangement underneath it moves.
